description: Convert units to integer capacity at a nonnegative integer rate.

methods.name: Scale
methods.header:
method Scale(units: int, rate: int) returns (r: int)
  requires units >= 0 && rate >= 0
  ensures r == units * rate

mutants.violation: Addition is not multiplication, e.g. 3 units at rate 4.

provenance: Locally authored quota-domain diagnostic. Not a public/industrial PSM, independent external source, or held-out benchmark.
